semanticNodes.canonicalMeaning: Technical score value for the proposal entity
semanticNodes.structuralScopeDescription: Represents a specific evaluation metric (technical scoring) within a tabular row structure, distinct from pricing or naming fields.
semanticNodes.organizationalFunction: Isolates the technical performance assessment data point from adjacent financial and identification fields in the table cell.

semanticNodes.canonicalMeaning: Proposed price value for the proposal entity
semanticNodes.structuralScopeDescription: Represents a specific financial metric (proposal pricing) within a tabular row structure, distinct from technical scores or evaluated costs.
semanticNodes.organizationalFunction: Isolates the vendor's requested price data point from adjacent technical and cost-evaluation fields in the table cell.
